description: Main entry point for a Flutter application that sets up app initialization, environment variables, dependency injection via Provider, and the root widget (MyApp). It includes initialization of a database, environment variable loading, and widget tree setup.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root Flutter application widget that provides app-wide dependencies and manages the main state and database connection.

classes.name: _MyAppState
classes.description: State class for MyApp that handles database initialization and provides the widget tree with dependency providers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initializes Flutter bindings, loads environment variables, and runs the app.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the database asynchronously without blocking the UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method that constructs the widget tree, injecting dependencies via providers.
